policy: Deterministic closure rules for provider-scoped metadata records. A rule never overrides an observed fact and is always recorded per field as basis=inferred with its rule_key. unsupported and not-applicable are determinate outcomes distinct from unknown. Rules must stay anchored to the cited official sources.
encoding_rules_additions: every provider-scoped metadata field is closed to a determinate outcome: an observed fact, a conservative inference recorded per field as basis=inferred with its rule_key, or an explicit unsupported/not-applicable outcome; indeterminate values do not survive closure
an inferred value is never presented as an observed assertion: each inference rule cites official or family evidence, and its per-field application stays inspectable through field_provenance
